title: Are Vision Language Models Cross-Cultural Theory of Mind Reasoners?

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring zero-shot performance disparities (accuracy variance) of vision-language models across different cultural regions and countries using the culturally diverse CVQA dataset split.

Evaluating models in a text-only (no-image) setting and using a sentiment classifier to measure 'Excess Positivity Drift', which quantifies how often models heuristically default to semantically positive or socially favorable answer choices in the absence of visual evidence.
